protectPdf.panelTitle: Set a password to protect your PDF
protectPdf.empty: Type a password, then type it again to check it.
protectPdf.note: Keep it safe. Nobody, including us, can open the file without it, and it can't be recovered.
protectPdf.strengthHint: Longer is stronger: try three or four unrelated words.
protectPdf.summaryOne: Done. {name} is protected with your password. Saved as {output} ({size}).
protectPdf.summaryMany: Done. {count} PDFs are protected with your password, in one ZIP ({size}).
protectPdf.needPassword: Type the same password in both boxes first.
protectPdf.alreadyLocked: {name} already has a password. Unlock it first, or remove it from the list.
protectPdf.unreadable: {name} couldn't be read as a PDF. It may be damaged. Remove it and try again.

diagram.caption: The PDF is encrypted with AES-256. Any PDF reader asks for the password before showing a page.

unlockPdf.arrangeHint: Type the password for any PDF that asks for one.
unlockPdf.intro: Removes the password and any limits on printing, copying or editing.
unlockPdf.restrictedOnly: No password needed: limits will be removed
unlockPdf.ownNote: Only unlock files you own or have permission to change.
unlockPdf.summaryMany: Done. {count} PDFs are unlocked, in one ZIP ({size}).
unlockPdf.wrongPassword: That password doesn't open {name}. Check it, including capital letters, and try again.
unlockPdf.notProtected: {name} isn't protected, so there's nothing to unlock. Remove it from the list.
unlockPdf.unreadable: {name} couldn't be read as a PDF. It may be damaged. Remove it and try again.

diagram.caption: Type the password once. The new PDF opens, prints and copies without it.

repairPdf.arrangeHint: Add damaged PDFs. Each one is repaired on its own.
repairPdf.intro: Fixes PDFs that won't open, show blank pages or report errors, such as files cut short by a failed download.
repairPdf.note: Parts of a file that are missing can't be brought back, but everything still inside it is kept.
repairPdf.locked: {name} needs its password. Unlock it first with Unlock PDF, then repair it.
repairPdf.summaryClean: Done. {name} had no damage to repair. Saved a clean copy as {output} ({size}).
repairPdf.summaryMany: Done. {fixed} of {count} PDFs needed repairs. All saved in one ZIP ({size}).
repairPdf.unreadable: {name} is too damaged to repair, or isn't a PDF. Try the original source of the file again.

diagram.caption: The file's table of contents is rebuilt from the pages still inside it, so readers can open it again.

pdfToText.arrangeHint: Each PDF becomes its own text file.
pdfToText.intro: Takes every word out of each PDF, in reading order, as a plain text file. Lines and paragraphs are kept.
pdfToText.markersHint: A line such as "--- Page 2 ---" before each page's text.
pdfToText.note: Scanned pages are pictures with no text to take out. Run OCR PDF on them first.
pdfToText.summaryOne: Done. The text of {name} is saved as {output} ({size}).
pdfToText.summaryMany: Done. {count} text files, all saved in one ZIP ({size}).
pdfToText.summarySkipped: Done. {count} text files in one ZIP ({size}). {skipped} PDFs had no text to take out; run OCR PDF on them first.
pdfToText.noText: {name} has no text to take out: its pages are pictures, like a scan. Run OCR PDF on it first, then try again.
pdfToText.noTextMany: None of these PDFs has text to take out: their pages are pictures, like scans. Run OCR PDF on them first.
pdfToText.encrypted: {name} needs its password. Unlock it first with Unlock PDF, then try again.
pdfToText.unreadable: {name} couldn't be opened. It may be damaged; try Repair PDF first.

diagram.caption: The words come out in reading order, line by line, with a blank line between paragraphs. Bangla letters stay as they are.

comparePdf.arrangeHint: The first PDF is the original, the second the changed version. Drag them to swap.
comparePdf.intro: Finds every word removed or added between two versions of a document, and shows the pages side by side.
comparePdf.note: The words are compared, not pictures or layout. Scanned PDFs have no words to compare; run OCR PDF on them first.
comparePdf.extra: Not compared: only two PDFs at a time
comparePdf.addSecond: Add the changed version to compare with.
comparePdf.needTwo: Choose exactly two PDFs: the original and the changed version.
comparePdf.noText: Neither PDF has words to compare. If they're scans, run OCR PDF on them first.
comparePdf.summary: Done. {removed} removed and {added} added. Saved side by side as {output} ({size}).
comparePdf.summarySame: Done. The words are the same in both PDFs. Saved side by side as {output} ({size}).
comparePdf.encrypted: {name} needs its password. Unlock it first with Unlock PDF, then compare.
comparePdf.unreadable: {name} couldn't be opened. It may be damaged; try Repair PDF first.

diagram.caption: Each page of the original sits beside the same page of the changed version. Words taken out are red on the left; words put in are green on the right.

fillPdfForms.arrangeHint: Type into the form's boxes on the pages below.
fillPdfForms.fieldsOne: This form has 1 box to fill in.
fillPdfForms.fieldsMany: This form has {count} boxes to fill in.
fillPdfForms.noFields: This PDF has no form boxes to fill in. To type anywhere on its pages, use Edit PDF.
fillPdfForms.flattenHint: They become part of the page and can't be changed. Leave it off to keep the form editable.
fillPdfForms.noFieldsError: {name} has no form boxes to fill in. Use Edit PDF to type on its pages.
fillPdfForms.encrypted: {name} needs its password. Unlock it first with Unlock PDF, then fill it in.
fillPdfForms.unreadable: {name} couldn't be opened. It may be damaged; try Repair PDF first.
fillPdfForms.summary: Done. {name} is filled in, and its boxes can still be changed. Saved as {output} ({size}).
fillPdfForms.summaryFlat: Done. {name} is filled in, with the answers locked in. Saved as {output} ({size}).

diagram.name: Nusrat Jahan
diagram.caption: You type straight into the form's own boxes, where they are on the page. Saved answers stay editable, or are locked in when you choose.

redactPdf.arrangeHint: Mark what to black out, by searching or by dragging on the pages.
redactPdf.foundNone: "{query}" wasn't found. Scanned pages have no text to search; drag over them instead.

hints.mark: Drag on a page to cover an area. Drag a box to move it, or its corner to resize it.
hints.move: Drag a box to move it, or its corner to resize it. Pages scroll as usual.

redactPdf.note: Marked pages become pictures, so nothing under a box can be copied back out. Their other text can't be selected either. Pages with nothing marked stay as they are.
redactPdf.needBox: Mark something to black out first, by searching or by dragging on a page.
redactPdf.encrypted: {name} needs its password. Unlock it first with Unlock PDF, then redact it.
redactPdf.unreadable: {name} couldn't be opened. It may be damaged; try Repair PDF first.
redactPdf.summary: Done. {areas} blacked out on {pages} of {name}. Saved as {output} ({size}).

diagram.caption: A black box alone can be lifted off to read what's under it. Here the marked page is redrawn as a picture with the box painted in, so the hidden words aren't in the file at all.

editPdf.arrangeHint: Choose a tool, then tap or drag on a page.

hints.select: Tap something you added to move it, resize it from its corner, or change its look. Arrow keys move it; Delete removes it.
hints.text: Tap a page where the text should start, then type. English and Bangla both work.
hints.image: Choose a picture. It goes on the page in view, ready to move and resize.
hints.draw: Draw on a page with your finger, pen or mouse.
hints.rect: Drag on a page to draw a rectangle.
hints.ellipse: Drag on a page to draw an ellipse.
hints.line: Drag on a page to draw a line.
hints.highlight: Drag over text to highlight it.
hints.whiteout: Drag over anything to cover it with white.

editPdf.imageFailed: That picture couldn't be opened. Try a JPG or PNG.
editPdf.needEdit: Add something to a page first: text, a picture, a shape or a drawing.
editPdf.encrypted: {name} needs its password. Unlock it first with Unlock PDF, then edit it.
editPdf.unreadable: {name} couldn't be opened. It may be damaged; try Repair PDF first.
editPdf.summaryOne: Done. {changes} on 1 page of {name}. Saved as {output} ({size}).
editPdf.summaryMany: Done. {changes} on {pages} pages of {name}. Saved as {output} ({size}).

diagram.caption: What you add is drawn into the PDF, on top of the page, exactly where you put it. Whiteout covers what's underneath with white.

ocrPdf.arrangeHint: Add scanned PDFs. Each one is read on its own.
ocrPdf.intro: Reads the words on scanned pages, so you can search, select and copy them. The pages look exactly as before.
ocrPdf.languagesHint: Choose every language the document is written in.
ocrPdf.note: The reader for each language downloads once, the first time you use it (English 3 MB, Bangla 1.4 MB). After that it works offline.
ocrPdf.summaryRead: Done. {name} can now be searched and copied. Saved as {output} ({size}).
ocrPdf.summaryNothing: Done, but no words were found in {name}. Check the language, or try a sharper scan. Saved as {output} ({size}).
ocrPdf.summaryHadText: {name} already has text you can search and copy, so nothing needed reading. Saved a copy as {output} ({size}).
ocrPdf.summarySkipped: {pages} already had text and were left as they were.
ocrPdf.summaryMany: Done. Read {pages} in {count} PDFs. All saved in one ZIP ({size}).
ocrPdf.tooMany: OCR reads up to {max} pages at a time. Split the PDF with Split PDF, then read each part.
ocrPdf.locked: {name} needs its password. Unlock it first with Unlock PDF, then try again.
ocrPdf.unreadable: {name} couldn't be opened. It may be damaged; try Repair PDF first.

diagram.caption: The page still looks the same. Underneath, each word is placed where it was read, so search, select and copy work like in any PDF.

pdfToJpg.arrangeHint: Choose how to convert. Each PDF's pictures come out in the order of this list.
pdfToJpg.pagesInfoOne: Every page of this PDF will be converted into a JPG file.
pdfToJpg.pagesInfoMany: Every page of these PDFs will be converted into a JPG file.
pdfToJpg.imagesInfo: All embedded images inside the PDF will be extracted as JPG images.
pdfToJpg.summaryPages: Done. {count} pages saved as JPG images, in one ZIP ({size}).
pdfToJpg.summaryImages: Done. {count} pictures saved as JPG images, in one ZIP ({size}).
pdfToJpg.noImages: No pictures were found in {name}. Choose Page to JPG to save its pages as pictures instead.
pdfToJpg.noImagesMany: No pictures were found in these PDFs. Choose Page to JPG to save their pages as pictures instead.
pdfToJpg.tooMany: That makes more than {max} pictures. Convert fewer pages at a time, or split the PDF first.
pdfToJpg.encrypted: {name} has a password. Remove the password, or remove the file, and try again.
pdfToJpg.unreadable: {name} couldn't be read as a PDF. It may be damaged. Remove it and try again.

diagram.captionPages: Page to JPG: each of the 3 pages becomes its own JPG picture, text and all.
diagram.captionImages: Extract images: only the 2 photos placed in the PDF are saved, each at its own size.

pdfToPng.arrangeHint: Choose how to convert. Each PDF's pictures come out in the order of this list.
pdfToPng.pagesInfoOne: Every page of this PDF will be converted into a PNG file.
pdfToPng.pagesInfoMany: Every page of these PDFs will be converted into a PNG file.
pdfToPng.imagesInfo: All embedded images inside the PDF will be extracted as PNG images, see-through parts and all.
pdfToPng.backgroundHint: Transparent leaves the paper out, so only the text and pictures are kept. Good for logos and stamps.
pdfToPng.summaryPages: Done. {count} pages saved as PNG images, in one ZIP ({size}).
pdfToPng.summaryImages: Done. {count} pictures saved as PNG images, in one ZIP ({size}).
pdfToPng.noImages: No pictures were found in {name}. Choose Page to PNG to save its pages as pictures instead.
pdfToPng.noImagesMany: No pictures were found in these PDFs. Choose Page to PNG to save their pages as pictures instead.
pdfToPng.tooMany: That makes more than {max} pictures. Convert fewer pages at a time, or split the PDF first.
pdfToPng.encrypted: {name} has a password. Remove the password, or remove the file, and try again.
pdfToPng.unreadable: {name} couldn't be read as a PDF. It may be damaged. Remove it and try again.

diagram.captionPages: Page to PNG: each of the 3 pages becomes its own PNG picture, text and all.
diagram.captionImages: Extract images: only the 2 photos placed in the PDF are saved, each at its own size.

addPageNumbers.arrangeHint: Choose where the numbers go. The pages below show them as they'll look.
addPageNumbers.whichPages: Which pages do you want to number?
addPageNumbers.customHint: Use {n} for the page number and {p} for the last number. Bangla works too, such as পৃষ্ঠা {n}.
addPageNumbers.textError: This text couldn't be drawn. Try again, or choose another text.
addPageNumbers.summaryOne: Done. Page numbers added to {name}, saved as {output} ({size}).
addPageNumbers.summaryMany: Done. Page numbers added to {count} PDFs, saved in one ZIP ({size}).
addPageNumbers.encrypted: {name} has a password. Remove the password, or remove the file, and try again.
addPageNumbers.unreadable: {name} couldn't be read as a PDF. It may be damaged. Remove it and try again.

diagram.captionSingle: Single page: every number sits in the same corner, here the bottom right.
diagram.captionFacing: Facing pages: numbers move to the outer edge of each spread, like a printed book.

addWatermark.arrangeHint: Choose your watermark. The pages below show it as it'll look.
addWatermark.imageHint: JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF. See-through parts of a PNG logo stay see-through.
addWatermark.imageUnreadable: That image couldn't be opened. Try a JPG or PNG.
addWatermark.textError: This text couldn't be drawn. Try again, or change the text.
addWatermark.summaryOne: Done. Watermark added to {name}, saved as {output} ({size}).
addWatermark.summaryMany: Done. Watermark added to {count} PDFs, saved in one ZIP ({size}).
addWatermark.encrypted: {name} has a password. Remove the password, or remove the file, and try again.
addWatermark.unreadable: {name} couldn't be read as a PDF. It may be damaged. Remove it and try again.

diagram.captionCentre: One diagonal watermark across the middle of each page, at 50% transparency.
diagram.captionMosaic: Mosaic repeats the watermark across the whole page, so no part can be cropped out cleanly.

help.othersNote: Your file is copied to a computer you don't control.
help.oursNote: Nothing is sent to a server.
help.privacyCaption: Most online tools upload your file to their server to do the work. AnyTools does the work inside your browser, so your file never leaves your device.

meta.imageAlt: AnyTools: free PDF tools for everyday jobs, on any phone or computer

rating.thanks: Thanks! You rated it {score} out of 5.
rating.failed: Couldn't send your rating. Please try again.
rating.limited: Too many ratings from your connection today. Please try again tomorrow.

consent.title: Help us improve AnyTools
consent.body: With your OK, we use Google Analytics cookies to count visits and see which tools people use. Your files and anything you type are never included.
